# DeepSeek V4 Pro quickstart

On Together AI, it runs in NVFP4 with a 1M-token context window and supports streaming.

The model ID is `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813`. Pricing is $1.32 per 1M input tokens.

DeepSeek V4 Pro accepts up to 1M input tokens on Together.

Set the context window to at least 384K tokens for Think Max mode, and set `max_tokens` generously.
